faqList.question: What criteria must I fulfill before booking driving lessons?
faqList.answer: To commence behind-the-wheel instruction, you need an active Learner's Permit or temporary driver's license from local authorities. Carry your official permit along with flat, comfortable footwear for your initial session.

faqList.question: Are the academy vehicles fully dual-controlled and insured?
faqList.answer: Yes, definitely! All vehicles across our fleet feature certified dual-control pedal systems (emergency passenger brakes) and carry complete commercial insurance coverage to guarantee total security for novice drivers.

faqList.question: How many lesson hours do learners generally take prior to testing?
faqList.answer: The total duration varies according to each learner's progression and confidence. Typically, beginners take about 15 to 25 hours of certified training coupled with family practice to master reliable exam-level techniques.

faqList.question: May I hire an academy car for my license examination?
faqList.answer: Yes! Our Test Day Assistance options include a preparatory refresher lesson just prior to examination, dedicated car rental, and on-site guidance from your instructor at the test center.

faqList.question: Do you teach both manual and automatic transmission cars?
faqList.answer: Yes, our training fleet offers up-to-date manual as well as automatic cars. You may select your desired gearbox format during enrolment and switch anytime during your package.

faqList.question: What is your notice requirement for session cancellations?
faqList.answer: We recognize routines can shift! We kindly request 24 hours prior notification to modify or cancel appointments fee-free, allowing our instructors to make slots available for fellow students.

faqList.question: Are instructors officially certified and background-screened?
faqList.answer: Every instructor at DriveLearn is state-authorized, thoroughly criminal-record screened, and holds defensive driving credentials with substantial patient teaching track records.

faqList.question: Do you provide complimentary home pick-up and drop-off?
faqList.answer: Yes, we provide free doorstep pick-up and return from your residence, college, or office situated within our standard regional coverage perimeter.
